description:
On the tabletop in front of you there’s a clear, glittery slime with colorful foam beads, with a small clear plastic cup off to the left and a tiny white piece nearby.  
Both hands move in to grasp the slime as a two-hand object, pressing it together, then stretching it outward left–right into a long strip before folding it back in; the hands repeat this kneading cycle by pulling apart, compressing, and gathering the slime into a thicker lump, with the right hand occasionally lifting and repositioning the slime while the left hand steadies and presses it down.
